summary: Close-up of the host in the doorway, caught looking worried, who snaps into a huge grin and a thumbs-up for the guest.
framing: Close-up, eye level, static: host's head and shoulders right of centre. Edge of the open purple door with its brass knocker at the left, flat orange-red interior behind him with a band of grey-violet smoke haze along the top, blue-grey door frame at the right.

cast.visible: head and shoulders, plus his raised fist from 3980
cast.costume: light-blue suit, lilac shirt, pink tie

props: open front door (purple, brass knocker), left edge of frame, static

beats.action: head 3/4 left, eyes wide and round looking left toward the street, mouth a crooked worried frown; still for two frames
orange-red glow fills the doorway behind him; a soft band of grey-violet smoke hangs along the top of the opening and drifts slowly, whole shot
head ducks down and to the right, tilting; eyelids drop
eyes squeezed shut, head at its lowest and furthest right, mouth a wavering closed line
his fist starts to rise into the bottom-left of frame, thumb up (knuckles only on 3980)
mouth breaks into a toothy grin with the eyes still shut; on 3982 the eyes are slits and the head starts back up
head pops up and left to its final position, eyes snap wide open and round, brows high, wide clenched-teeth grin; thumbs-up arrives at shoulder height at screen-left of his face, sleeve visible
holds the thumbs-up and the fixed grin, eyes wide and unblinking, to the cut; only a 1-2 px settle of the hand on 3984-3986

notes: Camera: the move measured at 3979-3984 (zoom 0.979, cy +0.031) is a false reading. Measured on the door at the left edge (the only part of the background the character never covers): template match and phase correlation against 3976 give 0 px shift through 3982 and at most about 1 px vertical (at 640x360) from 3983 to the end, with no scale change; the measured cy would be about 20 px. The solver was following the host's head, which ducks on 3978-3980 and pops up on 3983. Treat the shot as static. The off-screen third voice is heard throughout (L62 to 3992, L63 from 3996); the host does not speak, his teeth stay together.
